subject: writing
title: Build a paragraph
blurb: Keep a paragraph to one idea.

items.prompt: A paragraph usually begins with a ___ sentence.
Which is the best topic sentence about dogs?
choices: Dogs are loyal and helpful animals.

items.prompt: The paragraph is about our school. Which sentence does NOT belong?
choices: Our school has a big library.

items.prompt: Which sentence best ends a paragraph about dogs?
choices: That is why dogs make wonderful friends.

items.prompt: All the sentences in a paragraph should be about:
